partner_result_applied.scope_used: absolute continuity for every nonzero quadratic pushforward of an absolutely continuous joint law; generic bounded-joint-density shell obstruction to continuity, forcing retention of original product structure

own_premises.scope: invertible 3x3 physical block affine density bound C3/sigma_min(B)
invertible 4x4 physical block affine density bound C4/sigma_min(B); every rank>=3 symmetric matrix has an invertible principal block of order 3 or 4
no law-uniform continuity modulus even for fixed A=I3; common modulus is not used

new_result.statement: For every real symmetric A with rank(A)>=3 and independent coordinates with probability densities bounded by one, X^T A X has a bounded continuous density. The finite height is matrix-dependent; no universal constant is proved.
new_result.mechanism: critical/far/bad-gradient remainder removal plus two-original-coordinate product-transversality chart and L1 pullback continuity, then principal-block conditioning and dominated convergence
new_result.sharpness_control: Rank two does not suffice for continuity: iid Uniform[0,1], Q=X1^2+X2^2 has density pi/4 on (0,1) and zero on (-infinity,0).

first_unresolved_implication: Prove a matrix- and dimension-independent linear small-ball bound P(X^T A X in I)<=C|I|; continuity is no longer an unpaid regularity step.
next_step: Feed the regularity closure to synthesis workers and return mathematical effort to aggregate-curvature/bank-aggregation methods that avoid the refuted single-minor/cross-rank3 dichotomy.
